top_signals.title: Tuttle Capital CEO: I Am Concerned About Rates
top_signals.summary: Matthew Tuttle, CEO of Tuttle Capital, says he is concerned about higher yields but expects another leg of the AI trade if rates remain steady. He also discusses the firm's ETF business on the sidelines of the KBFG Korea Conference in Seoul. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Interactive Brokers' Friedland on Risk Appetite
top_signals.summary: David Friedland, Regional Head at Interactive Brokers Group, says he isn't seeing a significant drop in investors' risk appetite. He also highlights demand for IBKR's services on the sidelines of the KBFG Korea Conference in Seoul. (Source: Bloomberg)
